findings.quote: extending an August that gained about 10% and ranked as its best month in decades
findings.why: Goldman's derivatives note says gold is having "one of its best months in decades (+10%)", not that August was the single best month in decades.
findings.fix: Change "ranked as its best month in decades" to "ranked as one of its best months in decades".

findings.quote: a falling market would force an estimated $163bn of mechanical selling out of that group (Bank of America)
findings.why: The context attributes the $163bn down-market selling estimate to systematic strategies as a whole (CTAs, risk parity and vol control), not to the vol-control funds the sentence has just described as maxed out.
findings.fix: Attribute the $163bn to systematic strategies broadly rather than to the vol-control group alone.
